select * from user
nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') email = #{email}

select u.id, u.nickname, u.email, u.icon, u.account_status as accountStatus, u.create_time as createTime, (select count(*) from article a where a.user_id = u.id) as articleCount, ui.name as identifyName, it.type_value as identifyTypeValue from user u left join identify_user_relation iur on u.id = iur.user_id left join user_identify ui on iur.identify_id = ui.id left join identify_type it on ui.type = it.id and it.status = 1
and (u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and u.account_status = #{status}
order by u.create_time desc
